verdict.rationale: Crossmint's API reference states that you can "explore the APIs and test them live from the browser" and that "the reference pages allow you to call the APIs directly from the browser". It also offers a 5-minute guided path to create a wallet and mint an NFT, and has per-endpoint reference pages (e.g. onramp/offramp create-order). Together these cover an interactive reference with runnable calls. The OpenAPI probe returning 404 does not contradict this, since an in-browser reference can exist without a spec at those paths. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the in-browser try-it works, documentation of runnable code samples across languages/SDKs, and a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).
